newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-FRENCH DRIVER KILLED IN LE MANS QUALIFYING.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FRENCH DRIVER KILLED IN LE MANS QUALIFYING.

text.p: Frenchman Sebastian Enjolras was killed in a crash in Saturday's pre-qualifying for June's Le Mans 24 Hours race, the first driver fatality in the event since Austrian Jo Gartner in 1986.
Enjolras crashed his Peugeot sports-prototype as it accelerated out of a corner. The car left the track and burst into flames.
Enjolras was competing at Le Mans for the second time. Last year he shared a car with compatriot William David, who spent several days in hospital after crashing.
